newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed narrowly mixed on Friday in moderate trade on some late buying and selling interest, brokers said.

They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were mostly firmer, lifted by shortcovering ahead of the weekend as the yen retreated against the U.S. dollar late in the day, but there was no follow-through buying interest here.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning except for some speculative two-way trade in the RSS3 contract. Most people were reluctant to open or hold new positions due to lack of fresh incentives," a local broker said.
"But some late local buying and selling interest emerged in the afternoon amid uncertainty over the near term direction of the market. Volume was moderate," the broker said.
At 0945 GMT, September RSS3 rose 0.25 cents to 104.00 U.S. cents a kg.
October/December rose one cent to 152.50 Singapore cents (US$1.07) a kg.
August TSR20 was indicated at 138.50 Singapore cents (US$0.99) a kg against Thursday's 138.25 cents.
